Thread starter: here's a useful Python snippet for API calls.

import requests

def fetch_data(url):
    response = requests.get(url)
    return response.json()

Works great for simple GET requests.

Follow-up: you can also add headers for authentication.

headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}
data = fetch_data("https://api.example.com", headers=headers)

like

Final note: always handle errors gracefully.
